source_groups.label: Opening tenth-house topic and principal significators
claims: The author introduces a separate tenth-house class of questions.

CHAP LXXXII Of Government Office Dignity Preferment
The chapter concerns access to government office, dignity, preferment, command or trust.
General medieval horary prescriptions, not a dated verified job appointment.
The ascendant and its lord signify the applicant.
The tenth house and its lord signify desired position, office, honors or command.
Job outcome is source-defined but not tied to a particular person.
ascendant Lord Moon joyned to Sun
Lilly gives conjunction or relevant joining of first-house lord and Moon with the Sun as a promising factor.
Precise grammar 'both joined' requires interpretation; preserve as conditional.
ascendant Lord Moon joyned Lord tenth
Alternatively union of principal significators with lord tenth is favored.
Do not imply every conjunction always succeeds regardless of other conditions.
Lord tenth behold tenth or therein
The ruler of the tenth may regard or occupy its own house.
have thing sought after not gratis
Lilly predicts the desired place can be obtained, but not without effort and resources.
He advises exertion and use of available friends.

source_groups.label: Moon or first lord in tenth, lighter lord and applying harmonious contacts
claims: He considers the fallback where principal significators are not joined with tenth lord.

He considers tenth lord in the first if it is a lighter planet than first lord.
Comparative relative speed/dignity condition not benchmarked.
The source predicts success under this placement even without an aspect.
Lord tenth ascendant conjunction sextile trine Lord first
The tenth ruler placed in first applying by conjunction, sextile or trine to first lord is an additional favorable condition.
He describes this route as obtaining the office with less effort.
Ease not same endpoint as office attainment.

source_groups.label: Tenth lord with benefics, ascendant and dignified malefics across page seam
claims: A joining of tenth ruler with Jupiter or Venus in any aspect is examined.

Mars Saturn or either in ascendant
The adverse planet or one of the joined planets must be in first for this branch.
Essential dignity by house or exaltation is required for the favorable malefic branch.
The planets are described as oriental and moving direct.
They must not be mutually opposed.
With these qualifications, Lilly anticipates appointment, but only after much petitioning.
Success and effort burdens are distinct.

source_groups.label: Reception and transfer of light through another person
claims: Lord tenth receive Lord first or Moon
He treats tenth lord receiving first lord or Moon as favorable.
Reception may occur in different house settings.
effected with much content and profit

Profit is extra endpoint, not synonymous with promotion.
planet transfer virtue Lord first to tenth
He considers transmission or translation of first lord's influence to tenth lord by a third planet.
Dependent on a third actor, not direct joining.
This route allegedly yields the office through another person's work.
He stresses that this assistance is by another rather than by the querent alone.
Do not count it as direct self-perfection.
observe if know such a man
The author advises identifying a real intermediary corresponding to the significating planet.
A tactical suggestion, not a known person.
The useful intermediary should be active or acquainted with the appointing authority.
Intermediary must have access; not any abstract supporter.
very like attain place by his means
Lilly expects attaining the post by that person's help.
Conditional forecast rather than factual placement.

source_groups.label: Applicant-initiated conjunction and strenuous attainment

Lord ascendant doth really come conjunction tenth

claims: Lilly considers absence of direct conjunction between first and tenth significators.

The latter malefic joins a benefic or Fortune.
The Fortune in turn joins tenth lord.
Lilly also describes variations where initial first-lord contact is with an Infortune.
Alternate chain ordering, not independent case.
Lilly still predicts eventual acquisition, but with many complications.
Extremely flexible historical rule, not a calibrated success model.
The route purportedly demands lobbying several different people.
He maps the people to planets in chain and the houses they rule.
Interpretive identity attribution, no external provenance.
Planets sextile trine Lord tenth great with him
Planets favorably aspected to tenth lord are taken to identify powerful acquaintances.
Let application be made to such
He urges the applicant to approach these people as allies.
A practical-sounding historical recommendation without outcome evidence.

source_groups.label: Benefics in first or tenth with conditional reception
claims: preceding Planet in first or tenth

Planet receives Moon or Lord first
